children: Kinetiq's planned Elysium network upgrade will enable HyperCore data access by 7 December 2026. The upgrade will let Elysium smart contracts read HyperCore order books, prices, and positions.

The new read capability will support the high-frequency trading and proprietary automated market maker (prop AMM) use cases Elysium is built for. These applications will be able to use HyperCore market and position data within Elysium smart contracts.

title: Kinetiq: Elysium upgrade enables HyperCore data access - By 07 Dec 2026
